q1_fp16_vs_int16_encoding.observed: Human identified FP16 sign/exponent/fraction encoding versus bounded integer encoding.
q1_fp16_vs_int16_encoding.correction: FP16 is also a finite approximation grid; INT16 represents in-range integers exactly.

q2_storage_vs_inference.observed: Human correctly separated unchanged storage precision from inference precision and linked FP16 overflow to correctness.

q3_quantization_mapping.observed: Human correctly calculated q=3 and reconstructed value=0.3.

q4_type_vs_deployment_support.observed: Human identified operator support and hardware capability; future evidence must make plugin compilation, optimized kernels and measured benefit explicit.

q5_bf16_tradeoff.observed: Human correctly stated that BF16 preserves range while sacrificing fractional precision relative to FP16.

capability_outcome: Minimum precision mental model sufficient to begin Phase 3.3 PTQ design under LEARN mode.
phase_3_3_authorization: Design and preparation only until the human approves calibration and validation criteria.
